verdict.rationale: Mastra is a TypeScript framework for building agents. The evidence shows that developers can build agents which respond to natural language, but it never shows the product itself being operated through natural-language commands. Setup happens via CLI commands and code (e.g., passing tools to an agent constructor), and Studio is described only as an interface for building and testing, so these are developer building blocks rather than natural-language control of Mastra.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
